# Projects

Public code repositories and data tools. Most of the interactive tools below are
also gathered at my research hub, [heterodata.org](https://heterodata.org). For
source material on related research, see the [Research](research.html) and
[TNSE](tnse.html) pages.

Each project lists its **website** and its **GitHub repository** side by side —
the site is the interactive explorer; the repo holds the code and data.

## Heterodata

*Research-Data Hub*

- **Site:** [heterodata.org](https://heterodata.org) — the hub linking all of the data sites.
- **Repo:** [github.com/andenick/arcanum-workspace](https://github.com/andenick/arcanum-workspace) — code and data.

The research-data platform that gathers the interactive data sites — Gerhard,
Shaikh Data, Lewis, Leonid, Leontief and StarCruiser — alongside the affiliated
standalone sites (freenic.org, volcker.org, foodberg.org, methodex.fyi,
nycvisualizer.com, jjmuni.com).

## Volcker

*Comparative Empirical Testing of Theories of Banking — my PhD dissertation*

- **Site:** [volcker.org](https://volcker.org) — the dissertation site.
- **Repo:** [github.com/andenick/arcanum-workspace](https://github.com/andenick/arcanum-workspace) — processing code.

**This is my doctoral dissertation**, written at The New School for Social
Research under the chairmanship of Paulo dos Santos. It tests twelve traditions
of banking theory against one another on a single harmonised panel of US banking
data, read through Anwar Shaikh's real-competition framework: a theory-prediction
matrix of 12 theories, 38 thinkers, 100 atomic predictions and 13 formal models,
run as pre-registered horse races.

The empirical base is a ten-dimension taxonomy of roughly 7,000 U.S. bank
failures (1865–2026) and the bank-panel datasets behind it, anchored on a
comparative refactor of Correia, Luck and Verner (2025) "Failing Banks" (QJE).
That refactor is published separately as
[failing-banks](https://github.com/andenick/failing-banks), an R package
replicating the paper (158K observations, 489 failures, 0.965 AUC).

## Gerhard

*U.S. Public Finance*

- **Site:** [gerhard.heterodata.org](https://gerhard.heterodata.org) — interactive explorer.
- **Repo:** [github.com/andenick/gerhard](https://github.com/andenick/gerhard) — code and data.

An interactive treatment of American public finance — federal taxation,
spending, deficits, debt, and the Treasury market over time. It is the
interactive companion to my written work on [duration and public finance, and
tax-revenue cyclicality](research.html).

## Shaikh Data

*National Accounts Replication (ShaikhTonak)*

- **Site:** [shaikh.heterodata.org](https://shaikh.heterodata.org) — interactive explorer.
- **Repo:** [github.com/andenick/shaikh-capitalism-data](https://github.com/andenick/shaikh-capitalism-data) — the *Capitalism* (2016) replication.
- **Repo:** [github.com/andenick/measuring-the-wealth-of-nations](https://github.com/andenick/measuring-the-wealth-of-nations) — the Shaikh & Tonak (1994) framework.

Replication and extension of Anwar Shaikh's *Capitalism* (2016) empirical data
and the Shaikh & Tonak *Measuring the Wealth of Nations* (1994) framework —
productive labor, net social wage, exploitation rate.

## Lewis

*International Economics and the Balance of Payments*

- **Site:** [lewis.heterodata.org](https://lewis.heterodata.org) — interactive explorer.
- **Repo:** [github.com/andenick/lewis](https://github.com/andenick/lewis) — code and data.

An international-economics platform covering the current account, the flow of
funds, and how the rest of the world finances the United States — and who
profits. It is the interactive companion to my [historical balance-of-payments
work](research.html#balance-of-payments-history).

## Leonid

*Soviet and Imperial-Russian Official Statistics*

- **Site:** [leonid.heterodata.org](https://leonid.heterodata.org) — interactive explorer.
- **Repo:** [github.com/andenick/leonid-web](https://github.com/andenick/leonid-web) — code and data.

A corpus overview and construction roadmap for the official statistics of the
Soviet Union and Imperial Russia — what the sources are, how they fit together,
and how the series will be built.

## Leontief

*U.S. Input–Output Explorer*

- **Site:** [leontief.heterodata.org](https://leontief.heterodata.org) — interactive explorer.
- **Repo:** [github.com/andenick/leontief](https://github.com/andenick/leontief) — code and data.

An interactive explorer over the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis Input-Output
accounts. Compute the Leontief inverse across 71 sectors and trace how demand in
one industry ripples through the rest of the economy, 1997–2024.

## StarCruiser

*U.S. Employment and Inflation*

- **Site:** [starcruiser.heterodata.org](https://starcruiser.heterodata.org) — interactive explorer.
- **Repo:** [github.com/andenick/starcruiser](https://github.com/andenick/starcruiser) — code and data.

A macroeconomic employment-and-inflation toolkit built on BLS, BEA and Federal
Reserve primary data and read through a heterodox real-competition lens. It
aggregates more than 1,100 registered series from FRED, BLS, BEA, Census, FDIC,
NBER, OECD and the World Bank into one documented dataset.

## FreeNIC

*Open Banking Regulatory Data*

- **Site:** [freenic.org](https://freenic.org) — interactive explorer over a curated sample.
- **Data:** [data.freenic.org](https://data.freenic.org) — the full Parquet release.
- **Repo:** [github.com/andenick/FreeNIC](https://github.com/andenick/FreeNIC) — code and data.

A public Python and R package plus a server providing programmatic access to
**4,965,894,572 rows of US banking regulatory data**. Coverage: 217,210
institutions, 1863–2026, across 58 base tables in 21 source families, with
15 query tools. Any researcher (or AI agent) can query the consolidated data
directly without writing custom adapters. The source families and their exact
spans are the timeline on my [home page](index.html).

## Foodberg

*Historical Food Price Explorer*

- **Site:** [foodberg.org](https://foodberg.org) — interactive explorer.
- **Repo:** [github.com/andenick/Foodberg](https://github.com/andenick/Foodberg) — code and data.

A full-stack web application (React + FastAPI) for exploring historical food
commodity prices across FAO, USDA WASDE, BLS, FRED, and World Bank data.
169,000+ records from 5 sources.

## Methodex

*A History of Economic Statistics*

- **Site:** [methodex.fyi](https://methodex.fyi) — interactive explorer, and an MCP API for AI agents.
- **Repo:** [github.com/andenick/methodex-web](https://github.com/andenick/methodex-web) — code and data.

The construction-and-revision history of economic statistics — for any series,
at any date, see how it was built and which governing manual was in force, with
citations back to that manual.

## HMDA Explore

*Home Mortgage Disclosure Act Dashboard*

- **Site (web version):** [hmdaexplore.com](https://hmdaexplore.com) — the actively developed web version.
- **Site (Shiny draft):** [andenick.shinyapps.io/HMDAExplore](https://andenick.shinyapps.io/HMDAExplore/) — the earlier interactive draft; slower to start.
- **Repo:** [github.com/andenick/hmda-analysis](https://github.com/andenick/hmda-analysis) — code and data.

An interactive dashboard for exploring **Home Mortgage Disclosure Act data,
2019–2023** — slice U.S. mortgage applications and originations by geography,
borrower demographics (HUD CHAS data), and lending institution. Built during my
research assistantship at The New School's Schwartz Center for Economic Policy
Analysis. Please allow the app a moment to spin up on first load.

## NYC Visualizer

*New York City Transit and Sidewalk Accessibility*

- **Site:** [nycvisualizer.com](https://nycvisualizer.com) — interactive maps.
- **Repo:** [github.com/andenick/nycvisualizer](https://github.com/andenick/nycvisualizer) — code and data.

A granular mapping platform over NYC Open Data and MTA realtime feeds. Two main
views: a live bus map showing every MTA bus and positioned subway train in near
real time, and a sidewalk explorer covering citywide sidewalk coverage and width,
block-level coverage-against-population equity, a street-condition overlay, an
ADA ramp-gap layer, and a per-stop accessibility index.

## JJ Muni

*Westchester County Open Data*

- **Site:** [jjmuni.com](https://jjmuni.com) — interactive explorer.
- **Repo:** [github.com/andenick/westchester](https://github.com/andenick/westchester) — code and data.

An open-data platform for Westchester County, New York — demographic analysis,
sidewalk infrastructure planning, transit accessibility and interactive mapping,
built as a React frontend over a FastAPI backend. This is an affiliated project
with its own owner rather than one of my own research sites.

## Anwar Shaikh Papers

*Archive at the Levy Economics Institute*

- **Site:** [digitalcommons.bard.edu/as_archive](https://digitalcommons.bard.edu/as_archive/) — public archive.
- **Repo:** [github.com/andenick/arcanum-workspace](https://github.com/andenick/arcanum-workspace) — processing code.

Approximately 35 boxes, 77,452 pages and 532 GB of digital content of Anwar
Shaikh's working papers, correspondence, lecture notes, manuscripts, course
videos and audio, and digitized VHS and cassette tapes, housed at the Levy
Economics Institute of Bard College. I am Lead Archivist. See
[TNSE](tnse.html) for context.
